messages:
Avery N.: FYI managers  we're trying to reduce last-minute churn. Final manager edits due Fri 2025-03-14 16:00 UTC. Please follow the upload checklist.

Becca T.: Where do we put mid-cycle transfers? I have two folks moving teams the week before.

Avery N.: Add HEADER tag `TRANSFER=true` and include new_team and effective_date in the header. We'll route those for manual review in calibration.

Diego R.: Contractors question: do we include temps in the main batch?

Samir P.: Contractors go in the same Manager Review Form but set `contractor:true` and end_date. Default: excluded from calibration unless manager asks.

Becca T.: Can new managers get a 20m walkthrough? I have one brand-new manager.

Avery N.: Yep — booked 20m prep slots Thu 2025-03-13 09:30 UTC and 15:00 UTC. Sign up here: https://go/redwood/review-prep.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Fri 2025-03-14 16:00 UTC" posted 2025-03-11 10:00 UTC. Reaction: :bell:

Diego R.: Quick import tip: reviewer names must match People Ops directory exactly (case-sensitive). If import fails, DM me a screenshot and the CSV slice and I'll run a small-batch fix.

Avery N.: Calibration blocks: Sat 2025-03-15 12:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (60m). If you have >7 directs request a private panel. We will close signups 1 hour before.

Becca T.: Sample blurb for teams to copy: `Reminder: Manager edits due Fri 16:00 UTC. Use Manager Review Form vX, attach evidence for any <=2 ratings, tag transfers/LOA in header. Ingest Sat morning.`

Samir P.: Exception rule reminder: late changes accepted only for LOA, termination, payroll errors, or formal corrections. Tag `EXCEPTION=reason` in header when you submit.

Avery N.: Thanks all — final checklist posted tomorrow morning and we'll lock the upload window. :pray:
